test_pybind11_basic_callbacks: test passing Python functions, lambdas, and partials as callbacks to C++ via pybind11
test_bound_method_callback: test passing bound Python and C++ methods as callbacks to pybind11 C++ functions
test_keyword_args_unpacking: test tuple unpacking, dict unpacking, and keyword argument passing in pybind11 callbacks
test_cpp_function_roundtrip: test roundtripping C++ function pointers through Python and back to C++ via pybind11
test_async_callbacks: test async callback execution from C++ threads calling Python lambdas with stateful closures
